ui.agents.pages.ask.heading_agent.role: Heading above the ask box on the Agents tab
ui.agents.pages.ask.heading_agent.length_hint: Two to four words in the English; a second-level heading in an 810 px column, so it may wrap but must not become a sentence.
ui.agents.pages.ask.heading_agent.note: The Teams pane has its own sibling key, phrase-for-phrase identical but for its object. The heading names the object the ask box creates; the box itself names neither, because it serves both tabs.

ui.agents.pages.ask.heading_team.role: Heading above the ask box on the Teams tab
ui.agents.pages.ask.heading_team.length_hint: Two to four words; same slot as heading_agent.
ui.agents.pages.ask.heading_team.note: Team counterpart of ask.heading_agent. Keep the two parallel so the sentence differs only in its object.

ui.agents.pages.ask.body_agent.role: Explanatory paragraph under the ask heading, Agents tab
ui.agents.pages.ask.body_agent.tone: Plain, explanatory, second person ('you'); two short sentences.
ui.agents.pages.ask.body_agent.length_hint: Two sentences; about 160 characters in English. Wraps to three or four lines at the 810 px measure. Keep the causal shape: what an agent is, then what the box does.
ui.agents.pages.ask.body_agent.note: A 'configuration run' is the product's term for the background run that writes the agent registry: use the term the target language already uses for it (ui.agents.config.dismiss/copy), do not invent a second name. The teams sibling says the same thing about a team.

ui.agents.pages.ask.body_team.role: Explanatory paragraph under the ask paragraph on the Teams tab
ui.agents.pages.ask.body_team.length_hint: Two sentences, wraps to about three lines at 810px; sibling of ask.body_agent.
ui.agents.pages.ask.body_team.note: A team has one managing agent and members it can hand work to. Keep 'configuration run' identical to the agent sibling and to ui.agents.config.* copy.

ui.agents.pages.ask.manual_agent.role: Link-style button under the composer: the manual route to the same job
ui.agents.pages.ask.manual_agent.tone: Quiet, lower priority than the composer; sentence case.
ui.agents.pages.ask.manual_agent.length_hint: One short line, about 22 characters in English; it sits at the box's left edge, so a long string may wrap under the box.
ui.agents.pages.ask.manual_agent.note: Starts with 'Or'. Do not translate this as a second 'Add agent' action: it is the alternative to asking, not a synonym for the roster's own Add agent manually (ui.agents.pages.add_manual.agent).

ui.agents.pages.ask.manual_team.role: Link-style button under the composer on the Teams tab
ui.agents.pages.ask.manual_team.length_hint: One short line; sibling of ask.manual_agent.
ui.agents.pages.ask.manual_team.note: Team counterpart of ask.manual_agent; keep the two parallel.

ui.agents.pages.add_manual.agent.role: Ghost button at the foot of the roster: create an agent by hand
ui.agents.pages.add_manual.agent.length_hint: Short: the roster column is 288 px and the button is full-width with a 16 px icon, so keep within about 20 characters in English; longer strings truncate or wrap.
ui.agents.pages.add_manual.agent.note: The manual counterpart of asking for an agent in words (ask.manual_agent is the invitation beside the composer; this is the roster's own last affordance). The Teams pane has a sibling.

ui.agents.pages.add_manual.team.role: Ghost button at the foot of the roster on the Teams tab
ui.agents.pages.add_manual.team.length_hint: Same 288 px slot as add_manual.agent; keep it short.
ui.agents.pages.add_manual.team.note: Team counterpart of add_manual.agent; keep the two parallel so only the object differs.
